Name: Ferngill Farm Subsidy Program- The Government Gives You Money
Author: dragonsir
Description:
No country can function without someone growing the food that people eat, so Ferngill has decided to subsidize its farmers. They may not have
much money to spare while at war, but even soldiers can't eat bullets.

Let's be real, the farmer works hard, but Spring Year 1 is rough. 500g is barely enough to buy 1 of each spring crop, and that's just year 1's selection. It can take forever to build up a decent profit, and you have more important things to do than grind for gold every day. It's time for your country's government to step up.
[size=5]
[b]Mechanics[/b][/size]
Your farmer will receive a letter in the mail along with 500g on the first of every month/season, starting on the first day of the game. That's it, 500g per month, forever.

I may upload different versions with different amounts in the future, maybe even one that increases every year.

[size=5][b]
Installation
[/b][/size]

[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]﻿.

[*]Download this mod and unzip this file into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][size=5][b]
